usedFor: SmartTask holds tasks and Google Docs holds your notes, so “Task Completion” can run “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “Task Completion” in SmartTask, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Each finished task adds a line to a document tab, so you get a running record of completed work.

watchOut: “Add or Replace Text In Tab” can overwrite a tab’s content, so set it to add when logging completions.
